answers.question: Q11
answers.correction: The substance holds. The dual-Standard-Model form first appears publicly in the Belgrade slides (talk Mon 9 Sep 2019; file Last-Modified 10 Sep 2019; PDF created 29 Aug 2019). It first appears in writing in Minic 2020 (29 Feb 2020), which cites only the school for it. The 2016-2017 statements are precursors of a different claim. Six corrections: (1) slide 5 puts the dual Standard Model forward with a question mark ('HIDDEN SECTOR?') and names metaparticles, not the duals, as the dark-matter quanta; slide 6 comes closest to 'matter on x̃ is dark matter'. (2) The INSPIRE reference list of FLM 2019 has 65 numbered references (69 entries), not 46; 46 is the number of linked records. (3) FLM 2019 was published online 15 Oct 2019 (issue dated 10 Oct), after the Belgrade talk, so it could only be an earlier written statement than Minic 2020, not an earlier public one. (4) The 2016 essay's excitations are extended non-local excitations of the same fields (NCFT-type dipoles), not dual partners. (5) Minic's Miami 2019 listing (#31) is confirmed, but its text is unavailable. (6) The 'one go' sentence of Jejjala, Kavic and Minic 2007 is verified; the same paper also speculates about 'the dark matter condensate'.

answers.correction: Three additions. (1) The Belgrade slide 4 writes out the static potential between metaparticles: it depends on the dual separation r̃ as well as on r (Yukawa in r − r̃, oscillating in r + r̃, a 'Friedel oscillation'), with no velocity dependence. record_contradictions.note: Re-checked independently. The slides at www.mphys10.ipb.ac.rs/slides/Minic.pdf have server Last-Modified 10 Sep 2019 14:52 GMT and PDF Creation/ModDate 29 Aug 2019; the file is linearized, with no incremental update. They state the identification. Slide 5: 'EACH PARTICLE OF THE STANDARD MODEL HAS A "DUAL" PARTICLE ... DUAL STANDARD MODEL (HIDDEN SECTOR?)' and 'METAPARTICLES φ(x,x̃) → DARK MATTER QUANTA CORRELATED TO VISIBLE (BARYONIC/STANDARD MODEL) QUANTA'. Slide 6: L_m(x̃) ≈ L̃_m(x), braced 'DARK MATTER SENSITIVE TO Λ AND L_m(x)'. The timetable (created 3 Sep 2019) puts the talk on Mon 9 Sep 2019, 11:15-12:00, and the abstract (Wayback, 25 Aug 2019) announces 'a new picture of dark matter and dark energy'. It holds pages 1-7, including 2′B's 'METAPARTICLES ⇒ (DARK MATTER & DARK ENERGY)', but not pages 24-25, so slides 5-6 are dated by the file's own dates. The record's 'whose content is unknown' is out of date; 'dated no later than its posting' stays true. record_contradictions.record_says: Root CLAUDE.md, 2026-11-02 entry: 'Minic and coauthors have identified dark matter with the degrees of freedom dual to visible matter in Born-reciprocal (metastring) string theory since 2020'
record_contradictions.note: 'Since 2020' is understated by the Belgrade talk (public 9-10 Sep 2019) and accurate for written papers: Minic 2020 is the first written statement read, and FLM 2019 (published 15 Oct 2019) is unread. The 2017 statements (1709.04388, 1801.00160) are verified, but they make metaparticles a model for modified-dark-matter quanta, not 'the degrees of freedom dual to visible matter'. The 2016 essay (1605.04361) concerns extended non-local excitations of the same fields, NCFT-type dipoles ('represent open-string-like dipole excitations'), whose charged members 'would not be “dark”'. They are not dual partners; the reader's 'non-local partner' is its own gloss. The point about the count of nine holds only on the record's own reading that the Minic 2020 abstract sentence states the identification (flag 64). On that reading 1709.04388 states the same thing in 2017.

record_contradictions.record_says: notes/literature-check.md §3: '... a 2019 paper of Freidel, Leigh and Minic not on arXiv, whose abstract mentions metaparticles but not dark matter.'
record_contradictions.note: The record's description is literally accurate. Minic 2020 §7 does cite the paper for 'dark matter ... represented by metaparticles [10]': [10] is IJMPA 34, 1941004, verified in the reference list. Its INSPIRE reference list includes the six MDM papers (refs 54-59: Ho-Minic-Ng 2010, 2011, 2012; Edmonds et al. 2014, 2017, 2017), Grosse-Wulkenhaar (62), Kaloper-Padilla (63) and 'The theory of metaparticles, to appear' (64). Correction to the reader: the list has 65 numbered references (69 entries), of which 46 are linked INSPIRE records, not '46 references'. My second retrieval attempt also failed (closed access; the publisher returned 403), so the content remains unknown. It was published online 15 Oct 2019, after the Belgrade talk.

record_contradictions.record_says: review/wiki-build-flags.md item 64: 'Minic and coauthors identify dark matter with the degrees of freedom dual to visible matter ... Minic 2020 (arXiv:2003.00318): "metaparticle quanta (the zero modes of the metastring) as the natural quanta of dark matter in this approach".'
record_contradictions.note: The abstract sentence makes metaparticle quanta dark matter's quanta. §4.3 describes the metaparticle as 'two particles that are entangled', and in this framework every Standard Model particle is a metaparticle (slide 3: 'ANY STANDARD MODEL PARTICLE → METAPARTICLE'). So the sentence does not say that the dual half is the dark matter, and 1709.04388 made the same claim in 2017. The dual-sector identification is in §5 (eq. 49, 'could be interpreted as dark matter Lagrangian') and §6.2 ('The proposal here is that the dual sector ... should be interpreted as the dark matter sector'). The flag's second quotation does carry the claim: Berglund, Hübsch and Minić 2021 (2010.15610 abstract), 'dark matter, on the other hand, comes from the degrees of freedom dual to the visible matter' (FOUND). Only the Minic 2020 quotation needs replacing, by §6.2.

record_contradictions.record_says: notes/literature-check.md §3, 'What their "dual" is': 'In the foundations it is the momentum side. ... Berglund, Hübsch and Minić 2021 speak of the "canonically conjugate dual space".'
record_contradictions.note: The phrase names x̃ = x_L − x_R, conjugate to x at the string scale. That holds in the 2019 essay (footnote 4) and in the 2021 paper the record cites: 2010.15610 §2 says 𝕏 'combine the sum ( x^{a} ) and the difference ... of the left- and right-moving chiral bosons on the string', with 'doubled “phase-space” operators' and [x̂, x̃̂] = 2πiλ² (FOUND). So x̃ is not the momentum p at ħ, and the phrase alone cannot show 'the momentum side' in the program's sense. But 'canonically conjugate' is meant literally: the authors call (x̂/λ, x̃̂/λ) phase-space operators (their quotation marks) and cite Born, Heisenberg and Jordan for the commutator. The record's sentence also rests on foundations that do say momentum. FLM 2017: 'momentum space is just another Lagrangian submanifold'; η 'labels its decomposition into space and momentum'; 'spacetime and energy-momentum space are put on equal footing in a unified phase space formulation'. Minic 2020 §4: 𝕏^A ≡ (X^μ/λ, P_μ/ε) on phase space. The citation of BHM 2021 is weak support; the sentence itself stands.

record_contradictions.record_says: notes/literature-check.md §3, 'What differs', the vacuum: 'The check found no such mechanism in the school's papers, where the classical spacetime label "corresponds to a choice" of polarization.'
record_contradictions.note: FKGLM 2021 (v1, 1 Apr 2021; the passages are in v1) proposes that 'the expansion of the Universe can act as a mechanism that selects the decoupling frame'. The breaking happens 'at the level of the vacuum sector': a choice of ground state fixes δ, i.e. which commuting combination x + αx̃ is spacetime. The record's own workflow files list this paper as a C1 'related' finding, so the check had it. The same paragraph, however, says 'the dual symmetry is fundamentally broken at the quantum level', because 'the dual Lorentz action is not a canonical transformation'. The symmetry is dual Lorentz, not Born reciprocity ρ; it is not presented as exact; and no potential or order parameter is given. 'No such mechanism' holds for the program's reading (exact ρ, broken spontaneously, η the order parameter). It overstates if read as 'no selection mechanism at all'. The sentence should name FKGLM 2021.

record_contradictions.record_says: notes/literature-check.md §3: 'it is correlated with ours by construction, where the program's couples to ours by gravity alone'; flag 64: 'Their dual sector is correlated with ours; #11's couples by gravity alone under strict P4 (row 7)'
record_contradictions.note: Eqs. (49)-(50) are a sum L_m + L̃_dm at zeroth order in λ. They are written on a gravitational background held 'non-dynamical' and end in '+ ...', so 'no cross term, share only the metric' is the reader's inference from the displayed terms. Beyond that order the paper asserts a Berry-phase-like coupling α′A_μ dÃ^μ/dt, through which 'dark matter quanta should be detectable', and a correlation 'via the dark energy sector' (modified dark matter). The Belgrade slide 6 says dark matter is 'SENSITIVE TO Λ AND L_m(x)'. No strength is given anywhere. 'Correlated' is the school's own word and stands; 'by construction' is the record's gloss for an asserted, unquantified coupling. The narrowing the reader proposes is already in the record: §3 reports the round-1 verifier's 'vanishing as λ → 0 or L → ∞' for BHM 2021.

Several readings need correcting: the eq.
